summary: Source Workbench result writes require matching identity, object payload and boolean true deletion confirmation before local effects or follow-up reads. Save/export reject nonobject drafts and parsed numeric overflow; backend/download failures are separate from input errors, and temporary download URLs are released even on activation failure. Twenty-five real Chromium controls use isolated mocked services, fifty new unit controls exercise receipt/input/error boundaries, and ten new real result API controls plus expanded JSON/SQLite regressions verify the backend separately. Draft preservation and old-read fencing remain protected. This is not installed, remote, arbitrary-precision, ambiguous-write reconciliation, power-loss or exactly-once qualification. No persistent archive or production Node dependency is added.
